items.label: Control surfaces free and correct
items.description: Move ailerons, elevator, and rudder by hand. Confirm full travel, no binding, and correct direction matches transmitter inputs.

items.label: Propeller secure and undamaged
items.description: Check prop nut torque. Inspect blades for nicks, cracks, or delamination. Confirm spinner is tight.

items.label: Center of gravity within limits
items.description: Balance aircraft at the marked CG station. Payload bay loaded and secured.

items.label: All hatches and access panels latched
items.description: Visually confirm nose hatch, payload bay, and wing root covers are fully latched.

items.label: Battery voltage above 16.4 V (4S nominal)
items.description: Check main pack on a calibrated voltmeter before connecting to airframe.

items.label: GPS 3D fix with ≥ 12 satellites and HDOP < 1.2
items.description: Verify on the HUD before arming. Wait for fix to stabilize for at least 30 seconds.

items.label: RC link RSSI healthy
items.description: Walk-test transmitter to ~20 m and confirm no link drops. Failsafe should be configured to RTL.

items.label: Telemetry link established with GCS
items.description: Confirm bidirectional MAVLink traffic and that vehicle parameters have loaded.

items.label: Mission plan uploaded and verified on map
items.description: Visually inspect waypoint sequence. Confirm takeoff and landing waypoints are correctly placed.

items.label: Geofence configured for operating area
items.description: Either polygon fence or circular quick-set fence active. Max altitude set per local airspace authorization.

items.label: Winds within operational limits
items.description: Surface winds ≤ 8 m/s, gusts ≤ 12 m/s. No precipitation. Visibility ≥ 5 km.

items.label: Airspace deconflicted, observers in position
items.description: Confirm NOTAM filed if required. Visual observers briefed and at their stations with comms.
